name: Zed
tagline: A fast code editor with collaboration and AI tools.
description:
Zed is an open-source code editor built for responsive editing, project navigation, and collaboration. It runs natively on macOS and supports extensions, language tooling, Git workflows, and optional AI assistance.

Open a project folder, edit with language-server feedback and keyboard-driven navigation, then review changes in Git. AI agents and hosted models can be added when they suit a project, while the core editor works without a paid account.

## Features

- Edit code with syntax support, extensions, language servers, and integrated terminal tools.
- Use collaborative editing and shared project workflows.
- Inspect Git changes and work with built-in agent and AI features when enabled.
- Use external agents or personal API keys on the free plan.

## Where it fits

Zed suits developers who prioritize editor speed and a modern integrated workflow. Extensions and language support vary by ecosystem, so an existing specialist IDE may still be needed for some platforms.

## Privacy and requirements

Local code editing does not require a Zed account. Collaboration, hosted AI, telemetry choices, and external agents each have separate network and data boundaries. Review what project context an agent receives before enabling it.

## Pricing

The Personal editor is free. Pro costs $10 per month for hosted AI access and unlimited edit predictions, with usage beyond included credits billed separately.
pricingDetails: Free Personal plan; Pro $10/month plus excess AI usage
